title: Evaluation of Control Chart Impact on Surgical Outcomes
brief_summary: This two arms parallel cluster-randomized trial will evaluate the impact of monitoring surgical outcomes using Shewhart control chart (intervention) on the occurence of major adverse events, among a large sample of French surgical departments. Trends in surgical outcomes before and after the intervention will be compared between arms.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

\- All adults needing a digestive surgery who are hospitalized in one of the 40 departments

Exclusion Criteria:

* Age \< 18 years old
* Hospitalization \<24 hours
* Absence of surgical procedure
* Ambulatory care
* Palliative care
* Organ transplantation
study_population: All patients operated in participating French public and private hospitals (cluster)
